_purpose: Feature-flag registry for integrations that require OAuth, an API key, or other per-user setup. Everything here is DISABLED by default so the core cross-mapping pipeline runs for everyone with zero configuration. Individual users opt in by setting enabled=true (or the env override) once they have provisioned credentials.

_how_to_enable.config: Set the flag's enabled=true in this file (or a local override copy passed to FeatureFlags).
_how_to_enable.env_override: Set DBZ_FF_<FLAG_ID_UPPERCASED>=1 to force-enable, or =0 to force-disable, without editing this file. Env always wins.
_how_to_enable.credentials: Provide the credentials named in each flag's `requires.env`. A flag is only EFFECTIVE when it is both enabled AND its required credentials are present; otherwise the code degrades gracefully and logs what is missing.

github_authenticated.label: Authenticated GitHub API
github_authenticated.description: Use a GitHub token for the framework monitor's github_release checks. Without it, checks still work against public repos but are rate-limited (60 req/hr vs 5000).
github_authenticated.degradation: Falls back to unauthenticated public GitHub API (lower rate limit).

cloud_render.label: Cloud browser render (JS-heavy pages)
cloud_render.description: Render JavaScript-required framework pages via a cloud render service so the crawler can extract download links from SPA pages.
cloud_render.degradation: Crawler reports js_required pages for manual review instead of rendering them.

nist_cprt_api.label: NIST CPRT structured API
nist_cprt_api.description: Pull machine-readable framework structures from the NIST CPRT JSON API (no key required, but off by default to keep the pipeline fully offline-capable).
nist_cprt_api.degradation: Use the bundled spreadsheets / OSCAL files pinned in source_manifest.json.

mcp_elicit.label: Elicit MCP server
mcp_elicit.description: Research-paper search/extraction via the Elicit MCP server. Requires interactive OAuth authorization, which cannot run headless.

requires.setup_url: Authorize via claude.ai connector settings or `claude mcp` / /mcp in an interactive session.

mcp_elicit.degradation: Skip Elicit-backed steps; note the gap in output.

mcp_google_drive.label: Google Drive MCP server
mcp_google_drive.description: Read/write source spreadsheets and reports from Google Drive. Requires Google OAuth.
mcp_google_drive.degradation: Use local files under canonical-sources/ instead.

connector_thoropass.label: Thoropass (GRC platform) connector
connector_thoropass.description: Pull live ER/local-control crosswalk data and evidence from a Thoropass tenant instead of the bundled CSVs.

connector_vanta.label: Vanta (GRC platform) connector
connector_vanta.description: Pull control status and evidence from a Vanta tenant.
connector_vanta.degradation: Use bundled crosswalk data; no live evidence.

connector_drata.label: Drata (GRC platform) connector
connector_drata.description: Pull control status and evidence from a Drata tenant.
connector_drata.degradation: Use bundled crosswalk data; no live evidence.

connector_aws_audit_manager.label: AWS Audit Manager connector
connector_aws_audit_manager.description: Pull assessment evidence and control mappings from AWS Audit Manager.
connector_aws_audit_manager.degradation: Use bundled crosswalk data; no live cloud evidence.

orchestration_hybrid_mode.label: Orchestration hybrid engine (declarative spec compiled to Workflow)
orchestration_hybrid_mode.description: Default multi-agent orchestration is driven directly by the manager via the Workflow tool. When this flag is effective AND a trigger condition holds (named/recurring workflow, deterministic replay required, or planned agent count over the size cap), the declarative skills/multi-agent-orchestrator/workflow.json spec is compiled to a Workflow run instead of hand-driven. The flag alone does not force compilation — a trigger must also hold.
orchestration_hybrid_mode.degradation: Manager drives the Workflow tool directly (the default, simpler path).

categories.external_api: Public or keyed HTTP APIs. Most work unauthenticated but a key raises limits or unlocks data.
categories.crawler_enhancement: Optional upgrades to the framework crawler (e.g. JS rendering).
categories.mcp_server: Model Context Protocol servers that require interactive OAuth — cannot be enabled headless.
categories.grc_connector: Live integrations to commercial GRC platforms; replace bundled sample data with a customer tenant.
categories.orchestration: Behavioral flags for the multi-agent orchestration bucket. No credentials; gate execution strategy, not data access.
